title: RolesConfig
description: The role map, content/roles.yaml (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §7.1): each Role (CONTRACTS §3.3) the MVP uses maps to exactly one UnitKind. NAVY joins in P3 (Q-GD-8). The loader checks the kind is one a VIEWER can play.
